work.title: Herren seer Dine Veie
The Lord Sees Your Ways
A la grace de Dieux
Drama med Sang i fem Akter
Drama with Song in Five Acts

history.p: The title of the piece is borrowed from the refrain of a known Parisian song of the time. According to reviews, Overskou's reworking consisted of removing as much as possible of the offensive in the French original.

incipText.p: Modtag da vort Farvel! Himlen skjænke Jer Held!
Min Barndoms svundne Glæder jeg gjenfinder i Dig
O hvilken Fryd naar man en Ven fra den elskte Dal gjenfinder
Dør fra Dør jeg maatte gaae
Send, Madonna! fra det Høie Styrke til min Moder ned!
Den Fryd at dele Venners Glæde
Tre Sous jeg og tre Sous Du?
Sødeste Nanette jeg i en Karet, laridette
Beed til Gud og tænk paa mig
Ud i Livets Trængsler og Farer

physDesc.physMedium: Bound in blue cardboard cover with leather spine. On the front cover a handwritten label, inscribed "Herren seer / dine Veie / Partitur / 376". Written in ink. Paper: 22 staves. Pages unnumbered. After the final double-bar: "Fine / 1842." and Gade's musical signature. On the penultimate page the music played on the stage.
